name: Bambu Lab H2D
nozzle_regions_note: Each nozzle alone reaches a 325 mm wide strip (left nozzle from the left edge, right nozzle from the right edge); both nozzles only overlap on the middle 300 mm. "total" 350 mm is the union and only usable when a part can be printed by either nozzle with identical filament.

warn.PPS: Very high temperature material; check Bambu filament guide for nozzle and plate.

notes: Usable volume depends on which nozzle prints: store and check per nozzle, never as one box.

clearance_mm.note: Starting values per side, for PLA at 0.2 mm layers. Replace with tolerance-coupon measurements.

spec_note: Nominal build volume, included nozzle, hotend and bed limits checked against the first listed Bambu Lab document on 2026-11-20. Slicer exclusions, clearance values and optional transfer compatibility are separate from manufacturer hardware specifications.
